review_type: independent source review only; no runtime, tests, build, install, or native UI run
A_outcome: SOURCE_PASS_FOR_REPRO: all ten ResultPreview callers now supply source; saved DOM replay snapshots tab URL/title with its rows, useExtraction and useAiExtraction carry run/capture source, and Copy for AI writes the sanitized Source URL. This addresses the reported Gutenberg omission in source. Native outcome remains unverified after this commit.

B_quality.finding: Saved network replay labels response rows with the page URL, not the matched request URL. NetworkTab previews selected.url, but runNetworkCapturePattern resolves rowsFromBody(latest.body) and runSavedPattern returns only rows; PatternsTab sourceAtRun captures tab.url. On a page whose API endpoint differs from the page URL, Copy for AI misattributes the data source.
B_quality.action: Return matched response provenance alongside replay rows and bind it atomically to the preview; add a saved-network replay copy assertion with page URL != response URL.

B_quality.finding: ResultPreview applies sanitizeNetworkUrl to every source URL; that helper deliberately removes fragments. Hash-routed pages therefore copy a truncated URL even when the fragment identifies the extracted page.
B_quality.action: Use a page-source sanitizer that masks credentials while preserving safe route fragments, or explicitly report source identity unavailable; cover distinct hash routes.

B_quality.finding: The new provenance guard mocks ResultPreview and asserts a prop; the copy guard tests ResultPreview separately. Neither exercises the actual saved replay-to-clipboard path or selected Network response/draft edits.
B_quality.action: Add connected replay-to-copy coverage for two page queries and a selected response versus edited replay URL filter; verify masking and retained ordinary query keys.

positive_evidence: NetworkTab derives extractedRows and safeSelectedUrl from the same selected event; search and replay-filter drafts cannot change the current preview. sanitizeNetworkUrl retains ordinary query bytes/order and masks recognized credential keys; selected Network extra credential keys are applied before ResultPreview. Doctor now uses diagnostic URL/title rather than active-tab metadata.
native_reference: docs/stabilization/reports/data-picker-long-native.json is the pre-fix installed Chrome reproduction: Data AI copy had a URL; Showcase AI copy omitted it. It does not verify commit 8ae31220.
integration_advice: Run root-owned guarded focused checks and installed Gutenberg Copy for AI after addressing or explicitly accepting the network replay attribution and hash-route findings; do not call the pre-fix native receipt a post-fix pass.
